lede: (oxblood, wet lacquer, red glass. five overlays that behave like the room: water-drop loupes, a headline that reflects, a cloakroom ticket numbered with the price, a wine list, a darkroom contact sheet.)
idea: The Red Room was the strongest roll the brand ever shot and its overlays never matched it: catalogue type on cinema pictures. This pass lets the room write the copy. The drops on the wet dome become loupes. The lacquer's own reflection mirrors the headline. The velvet roll earns a cloakroom ticket whose number is the price. The lacquer box gets a wine list with no vintage and no tarnish. The red-glass bangles become a safelight and a contact sheet with frame seven circled in grease pencil.
type: Ivory Velista on near-black red at 150px, the second word in lacquer red; the plate bleeds into the ground through a 120px gradient. Devices: CSS loupes that magnify the plate itself at 2.2× with a glass highlight and a leader line; a scaleY(-1) copy of the headline masked to fade; a dashed-rule ticket with № in Jost and the number in Velista at 136px; a dot-leader list with italic values; a film strip of 4:5 frames with sprocket edges and an SVG ellipse. Red CTA, white text.
review: Verification: every frame checked at full resolution. The hoops on the wet dome are archive frame #1536 (the full-resolution twin of the live listing hero, plait intact, no printed wordmark). The Prism reflection frame is the live listing hero, upscaled and cropped so its printed wordmark falls outside the plate. The Heartbead on velvet is the live listing hero: silver spheres, gold toggle, one heart — the audit's two-tone complaint was wrong, the listing states that. The chain over the lacquer box and the huggies before the bangles were generated tonight and checked against the listings; archive #1497 was rejected because its pavé link belongs to a different chain. Pass 1: loupes pointed at lacquer, the mirrored headline drew above the real one. Pass 2: loupes re-targeted from a grid in both formats, the reflection put in flow under the headline, the list enlarged, the pour plate cropped below the top bar.
verdict: LOOK CLOSER. is the one to run first; the loupes are a proof, not a decoration.

R1.title: LOOK CLOSER.
R1.why: The braided hoops on the wet oxblood dome with three water-drop loupes, each a real magnification of the plate: the plait, the absence of stones, a drop.
R1.source: Archive frame #1536 at 1856×2304, the full-resolution twin of the live listing hero.
R1.check: 25mm braid, no stones, waterproof on E20267O; 77 units.

R2.title: TWICE.
R2.why: The rivière on wet lacquer with its own reflection, so the headline reflects too: one bracelet, two of everything.
R2.source: The live listing hero for B00681C, upscaled 2× and cropped clear of its printed wordmark.
R2.check: 5mm cushion stones in pavé halos, rhodium, waterproof on B00681C; 77 units.

R3.title: CLOAKROOM.
R3.why: The Heartbead on a burgundy velvet roll and a cloakroom ticket whose number is the price. Redeem for one Heartbead bracelet. Keep this ticket.
R3.source: The live listing hero for YF5215.
R3.check: 6mm mirror steel, gold toggle, one gold heart on YF5215; 29 units.

R4.title: THE LIST.
R4.why: The paperclip chain poured over a wet lacquer box, read like a wine list: body 12g, length 50cm, nose none, finish non tarnish, served at the front or the side.
R4.source: Generated tonight (gen 7a7b3a17), one product, the box as the scale referent.
R4.check: 12g, 50cm, 4mm and the 15mm toggle on YF5143; 'non tarnish' and 'front or the side' are the listing's own words; 80 units.

R5.title: RED LIGHT.
R5.why: The brushed huggies in front of red glass bangles, presented as a darkroom contact sheet with frame seven circled: print this one.
R5.source: Generated tonight (gen 34a6c736), one product, the bangles as the scale referent.
R5.check: 12mm across, 6mm deep, brushed satin on E14776S; 16 units.
